zh: 把“每个位置选一个质数、再把所有数组的乘积加起来”反过来看：若把每个位置可选质数的和相乘再展开，每一项恰好对应一个数组的分数。
由乘法分配律，答案就是各位置区间内质数之和的乘积。问题变成快速求任意区间 [low,high] 内的质数之和，用筛法加前缀和即可。
取所有 high 的最大值 M，用埃氏筛标出 M 以内的质数，再算 prefix[v]=不超过 v 的质数之和（会超过 32 位，要用 64 位）。对每个位置取 prefix[high]−prefix[low−1]，先对 10⁹+7 取模再乘进结果，结果也随时取模。
en: Look at "choose a prime for each position and add up the products of all arrays" the other way around: if you multiply the per-position sums of allowed primes and expand, each term corresponds exactly to the score of one array.

By the distributive law, the answer is the product of the prime sums of each position's interval. The task becomes finding the sum of primes in any interval [low, high] quickly, which a sieve plus prefix sums handles.

Let M be the largest high. Sieve the primes up to M and compute prefix[v], the sum of primes not exceeding v (it exceeds 32 bits, so use 64-bit integers). For each position take prefix[high] - prefix[low - 1], reduce it modulo 10^9 + 7, multiply it into the result, and keep the result reduced.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sieve all primes and compute prefix sums of the primes. The sum of the primes in each interval is a difference of prefix sums; multiply these sums together modulo the given number.

## Correctness

Expanding the product of the per-position prime sums, each term picks exactly one prime from every position, and the term's value is that array's score; the arrays correspond one-to-one with the terms of the expansion. So the distributive law turns the enumeration of combinations into a product of interval sums.

## Complexity

Time O(M log log M + n), space O(M), where M is the largest right endpoint.
